## About
Rick's Power Muffler does exhaust and only exhaust. Anything exhaust or related to it, we can make it or repair it, for any make or model. We use high quality parts, and only by application.
When you pull in, you'll be greeted by Rick from the get go. He works off what you want for your exhaust, and he'll also tell you what he thinks is the best setting for you and your car. One reviewer said Rick called as soon as the truck was in the air to talk through options.
We keep prices competitive and look for the best deal for you. You'll find us on W Van Buren in Phoenix, rated 4.8 from 208 Google reviews.

## Services
- Repair-Complete Replacements: Exhaust repair through to complete replacement.
- Stock Replacements: Replacing worn exhaust parts to match the original setup.
- High Performance Replacements: Performance exhaust parts for drivers who want more.
- Custom Cat-Back Systems: Custom systems built for your vehicle, including dual exhaust.
- Diesel Exhaust Systems: Exhaust work for diesel trucks and vehicles.
- Catalytic Converters: Catalytic converter replacement and installation.
- OEM Compatible Catalytic Converters: Converters compatible with your vehicle's original equipment.
- Stainless Steel Welding: Welding work on stainless steel exhaust.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesels?
A: Yes. We do diesel exhaust systems and diesel catalytic converters.

Q: Do you carry California catalytic converters?
A: Yes, we offer California OBD II catalytic converters.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at (623) 225-0628 to set up a time.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 3846 W Van Buren St in Phoenix, AZ 85009.
